subject: Kickoff: MMMT-IF as the multimodal instruction-following gate
body:
Hi Daniela,

Kicking off MMMT-IF (Mar 16 – Jun 22). The benchmark from our open-source release is a genuinely hard one: image-based multi-turn Q&A where global instructions are added between questions and constrain the answer format. Models have to retrieve multiple instructions spread across a long chat history and reason over all of them at once — and every instruction is program-verifiable, so scoring is objective, no rater budget needed.

Why product cares: the assistant team keeps shipping models that pass single-turn evals and then drop formatting constraints by turn 12 in real sessions. This becomes the pre-release gate for that failure mode.

Milestones: mid-April, harness running in Evalline with the verifier programs ported; late May, baseline sweep across our three candidate checkpoints; mid-June, gate thresholds proposed for launch review.

Staffing and platform asks when you get a chance?

Thanks,
Priya
